description: Synthetic community groups on a fictional Maple St: four groups, 64 members, 37 events and two years of RSVP and post history. For reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. No real group, person or post.

sources.description: Hand-written people, groups, upcoming events, sheets and key posts, plus fixed-seed generated past RSVPs and monthly background posts (scripts/generate-fixture.cjs). Workflow structure (groups, roles, events, RSVPs, waitlists) follows Meetup's public help pages; the claim window, post audiences, child counts, sign-up sheets, member export and view-as are Stoopside's own rules.

transformations: Fixed UTC-05:00 group times; IDs stable across resets.
Deliveries are recorded for posts from 2027-01-01 on; older notification history was not imported.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace a human read of every member and event row.
